newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan key 3-mth CDs issued actively after tankan.
newsitem.headline: Japan key 3-mth CDs issued actively after tankan.

text.p: A large volume of benchmark three-month certificates of deposit (CDs) were issued at 0.55 percent after the release of the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) tankan corporate survey, traders said.

About 350 billion yen of the three-month CDs were issued as of 0130 GMT. The rate at 0.55 percent represents a view after the survey that there would be no change in the BOJ's low interest rate policy in the near future, they said.
"The tankan survey confirmed our view that it would be difficult for the BOJ to change its current monetary policy within three months from now," said a city bank dealer.
"Given the tankan, investors who had not been sure about that gave in, resulting in the CDs issued in a large volume," he said.
On Tuesday, some 50 billion yen of the three-month CDs was issued at 0.55 percent.
